from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p=Path('/Users/radoniusz/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Devices/53CBD69C-E05C-4DAC-9A2C-2504C42CB57F/data/Containers/Data/Application/B4834A56-4709-4E8D-9ED9-30026F3818A1/Library/Caches/@alice:localhost/Aggregations/Aggregations.realm')
out=subprocess.check_output(['strings', str(p)], text=True, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)
lines=out.splitlines()
for i,l in enumerate(lines):
    if l=='roomId':
        for j in range(max(0,i-5), min(len(lines), i+15)):
            print(f'{j}: {lines[j]}')
        print('---')
PY
